subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage architecture as the supported continuation of the Codex accounting fix, with legacy remaining authoritative until explicit promotion evidence is approved?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well proven, but it adds a large alternative accounting architecture, cache contract, performance cost, and future authority policy that cannot be accepted from automated correctness review alone.

options.title: Sponsor the reversible stack
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in exact dependency order while keeping legacy default and promotion disabled until the documented evidence contract passes.

options.title: Keep Phase 1 only
options.body: Leave the current-main containment fix in place and request additional real-world accuracy or performance evidence before accepting the lineage architecture.

options.title: Decline the architecture
options.body: Close the stack and pursue a narrower extension of the existing per-file scanner if the long-term cache and accounting model is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the reversible stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in exact dependency order while keeping legacy default and promotion disabled until the documented evidence contract passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and authored most refinements to the current-main accounting containment path and are best positioned to decide the repository's long-term scanner architecture.
